_README: Per-income-year IRS deduction rules, one self-contained rule set per year, for the past-year re-audit. A re-audit of year N MUST use year N's rules. Proven necessary: art. 78.º-E (rendas) changed in force in 2024, 2025 AND 2026, and is not a single ceiling but an escalonamento (15% base + majoracoes 50%/75%). Using today's value for a past year ships wrong numbers - the same green-but-wrong class as the Excel-serial and page-count bugs.
_structure: years.<income_year>.rules.<key> holds {pct, ceiling, ...params, verified, source_law}. One year is authoritative only when every rule in it is verified=true. Downstream docs (deducoes.html, cae_sectors.json, Bible ch.15) should READ the current year from here instead of hardcoding their own copy - today they each carry a separate copy with no cross-check. Expense and IVA rules (slice R, added 2026-10-07): each rule-year also carries value (number, object or true for a rule with no number), unit (EUR, %, coeficiente, IAS = multiple of that year's ias rule, prazo, regra, cae), source_id (legal_sources.json id), source_law and dre_text (the exact DRE wording the value was read from; every item is one of that source's expect / expect_by_year strings, so verify_sources re-checks it; for a past year the string must be in expect_by_year[year], unless dre_text_scope is current_page: a note on today's page that names the year). verified=false means DRE does not answer for that year: value is null and a reader must return unknown, never another year's value. A rule-year with in_force false did not exist in that year's wording: verified true, value null, in_force_from (ISO) and in_force_from_display (PT-PT, table form); the absence is checked by the source's expect_absent_by_year. An unverified year may carry in_force_from when the rule started mid-year. A value computed from several DRE strings carries derived {formula, base, rate_pct, texts[{source_id, on?, text}]}: each text is checked by verify_sources (expect, expect_by_year or expect_on_date) and value = base x (1 + rate_pct/100). derived.kind phase_in instead carries {formula, from, from_rule, from_year, to, share_pct, texts}: from must equal the verified from_year/from_rule value, to must be printed in dre_text, and value = from + share_pct/100 x (to - from), rounded to cents. Unit cae maps each alinea to one or more space-separated CAE tokens; numeric tokens must occur with digit boundaries in dre_text and letter sections must occur as 'seccao <letter>' after normalization. Integer EUR values accept either grouped or ungrouped DRE digits with digit boundaries; 100 % also accepts 'totalidade do IVA'. 2026 lives in current_values_2026_verified_isolation.rules (same shape); IRS brackets for 2026 in escaloes_irs.2026. Keys: ias, cirs25_1a_deducao_especifica, cirs31_1_coeficientes, cirs31_13_justificacao_pct, cirs31_14_parcial_pct, cirs31_15_prazo_portal, cirs31_16_valores_declarados, cirs32_remissao_circ, cirs33_5_habitacao_pct, cirs78b_4_fora_atividade, civa19_direito_deducao, civa20_operacoes_dedutiveis, civa21_exclusoes_pct, civa23_utilizacao_mista, civa53_limiar, civa53_3_sem_deducao. Personal-deduction keys: cirs78b_1_despesas_gerais_pct, cirs78b_1_despesas_gerais_limite, cirs78b_1_limite_por_sujeito_passivo, cirs78b_9_monoparental_pct, cirs78b_9_monoparental_limite, cirs78c_1_saude_pct, cirs78c_1_saude_limite, cirs78d_1_educacao_pct, cirs78d_1_educacao_limite, cirs78d_11_rendas_estudante_limite, cirs78d_11_rendas_estudante_acrescimo, cirs78e_1_pct, cirs78e_1a_rendas_limite, cirs78e_4a_rendas_limite_majorado, cirs78e_rendas_limite_ano, cirs78e_4a_rendas_limite_majorado_ano, cirs78e_1b_juros_limite, cirs78e_5a_juros_limite_majorado, cirs78f_1_iva_pct, cirs78f_1_limite_agregado, cirs78f_3_passes_pct, cirs78f_6_medicamentos_veterinarios_pct, cirs78f_7_jornais_revistas_pct, cirs78f_ginasios_pct, cirs78f_1_setores, cirs84_1_lares_pct, cirs84_1_lares_limite.
_provenance: Values come from each article's DEDICATED DRE page (2014-70048167-<id>), which exposes the in-force text + full 'Alteracoes ao artigo' history; the full consolidated render does NOT expose those accordions. Historical (past-year) text is read by viewing the article as-in-force at that year. source_law names the diploma that set the value for that year.
_correction_windows: How long each past year stays fixable is separate, in legal_sources.json: cppt-59 (substituicao), cppt-70 (reclamacao graciosa 120 dias), lgt-78 (revisao 4 anos, com limites).
_status: COMPLETE for 2023/2024/2025 and current 2026 base values (reviewed 2026-08-22): all 6 base ceilings plus global-limit and dependent structures. The 2025 rent ceiling is confirmed by Lei 36/2024 and the AT's 2025 deductions table; the 2026 rent ceiling is confirmed by DL 97/2026. Refinements remain for income-bracket-dependent increases.
_method_proven: Historical (past-year) values come from the OE law's own consolidated ARTICLE page (small, ~13k chars, clean via dre.mjs get), NOT the SPA version-at-date control and NOT the 200-page OE PDF. Workflow, deterministic: (1) the CIRS article's amendment history names the amending law+article, e.g. '78.º-E <- Lei 82/2023, art. 230'; (2) search 'OE <year> Artigo <N>' for that page's id (ids are non-sequential OutSystems content ids, not guessable, but search finds them); (3) dre.mjs get that page; (4) parse the redacao block '«Artigo N ...»' - the format is legally standardized across every OE, so the parser generalizes. PROVEN 2026-07-23: OE-2024 art 230 (2023-836109751-836144477) yields 78.º-E 2024 base rendas limit = 600 EUR (n.4 adds escalonamento: 900 EUR for rendimento coletavel <= 1st escalao). Current single-article isolation from the full consolidated render also works via the fixed line-anchored matcher (no re-render needed).
_rule_latest_amendment_per_year: For income year Y, an article's value is the redacao set by the last amendment producing effects for Y. Lei 82/2023 sets 600 EUR for 2024; Lei 36/2024 enters into force on 2025-01-01 and applies 50% of its 600-to-800 increase in 2025, yielding 700 EUR.

Lei 9-A/2026) aditou o n.10 ('elevado para 1000,00 EUR, sem prejuizo do n.4 quando o limite dai resultante seja superior') e a norma transitoria art. 15.o n.1 manda aplicar 900,00 EUR no ano de 2026, ficando os 1.000 para 2027 em diante. O proprio preambulo do DL diz 'aumento progressivo, para 900 EUR em 2026 e para 1000 EUR a partir de 2027', o que confirma a leitura da transitoria. Efeitos das alteracoes ao CIRS a 01-01-2026 (art. 18.o n.2). Escalonamento n.4: <=1.o escalao 1100, formula ate 30000; JUROS 296/450. Lido do PDF oficial do DR (files.diariodarepublica.pt/1s/2026/05/09700/0001400040.pdf) em 2026-07-30, relido 2026-07-31. NOTA: a pagina dedicada consolidada lida em 2026-07-28 ainda mostrava 800 no n.1 a) e nao expunha o n.10 - o teto real nao esta todo na alinea, esta na transitoria do DL.
current_values_2026_verified_isolation.78.º-E_2027: 1000 (n.10 na redacao do DL 97/2026). Ainda NAO entra em RENDAS_CAP_ANO: o test-deducoes-sync trata a chave mais recente como ano corrente.

art56_impedimentos._fonte: pagina dedicada DRE do art. 56 CIVA. Lido 2026-07-28. Redaccao atual dada pelo art. 2.o do DL 35/2025, DR 58/2025 Serie I de 2025-03-24, em vigor desde 2025-03-29. n.1 REVOGADO.
art56_impedimentos.n2_a: Nos 12 MESES SEGUINTES ao da cessacao, quem estivesse enquadrado num REGIME DE TRIBUTACAO a data da cessacao e reinicie ESSA OU OUTRA atividade NAO pode beneficiar da isencao. 'Outra atividade' esta expresso: mudar de CAE nao contorna.
art56_impedimentos.n2_b: No ANO SEGUINTE ao da cessacao, se ao reiniciar seria enquadrado no regime normal por forca do art. 58.o n.2 a) - ou seja, se o volume de negocios do ano civil anterior tiver excedido os 15.000 EUR do art. 53.o n.1.
art56_impedimentos.consequencia_pratica: Um REINICIO nao volta automaticamente a isencao, e e ISTO que o assistente da AT aplica quando mostra 'o seu enquadramento em IVA neste momento e: Normal Trimestral'. CONFIRMADO empiricamente a 2026-07-28: com data de inicio dentro da janela dos 12 meses saiu Normal Trimestral; movendo a data para depois de 2026-09-30 saiu 'isento ao abrigo do artigo 53'. O CAE, o volume estimado e a resposta profissional/empresarial nao alteram nada disto.
art56_impedimentos.art55_lock_a_verificar: Art. 55 n.3: quem OPTA pelo regime de tributacao fica obrigado a permanecer nele pelo menos CINCO anos; n.4 so admite a declaracao de regresso em Janeiro de um ano seguinte ao termo do prazo; n.5 abre excepcao por 'modificacao essencial das condicoes de exercicio' mediante requerimento no servico de financas.
